name: How long does a typical drywall repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical drywall repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of drywall repair depends significantly on the extent and type of damage. Small patch jobs, like filling nail holes, might take a few hours, including drying time for spackle and paint. Larger repairs, such as replacing a section due to water damage or impact, typically require multiple steps: cutting out the damaged area, installing new drywall, taping seams, applying multiple layers of joint compound, sanding, and priming. This multi-step process often spans one to three days, allowing for proper drying time between coats of compound to achieve a smooth finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Small drywall repairs can take a few hours, while larger repairs involving patching, taping, and multiple compound layers may take one to three days due to drying times.
